lead_ministry_or_agency: Ministry of Home Affairs (National Registration Department)
mandate_basis: Registration of births and identity documents, and processing of citizenship applications, are functions of the National Registration Department under the Ministry of Home Affairs
supporting_agencies: Prime Minister's Department (delivery secretariat); Ministry of Education; Department of Social Welfare; state governments; legal-aid organisations
escalation_route: Named ministry delivery officer and accounting officer; automatic escalation under GC-06 to the senior-officials committee; unresolved policy questions to Cabinet
notes: Citizenship determinations under Articles 15 and 16 of the Federal Constitution rest with the Minister and cannot be delegated to a task force. The Task Force may set service standards for processing but not for outcomes.

mandate_basis: Preschool education policy and registered preschool provision fall within the Ministry of Education's mandate
supporting_agencies: KEMAS (Ministry of Rural and Regional Development); Department of National Unity; state education departments; community organisations
escalation_route: Named ministry delivery officer and accounting officer; automatic escalation under GC-06 to the senior-officials committee
notes: Multi-provider delivery (MOE, KEMAS, PERPADUAN, registered private) requires an inter-agency subsidy protocol so the subsidy is net of assistance already received.

programme_name: SJKT Safety and Learning Environment Programme
mandate_basis: National-type schools are within the national education system and their capital and maintenance funding is an MOE function
supporting_agencies: Public Works Department; state education departments; school boards and PIBG; MITRA
escalation_route: Named ministry delivery officer and accounting officer; automatic escalation under GC-06 to the senior-officials committee; capital scope changes to MOF
notes: Many SJKT sites sit on land not owned by the federal government, which constrains capital works. Land status must be established during the audit.

programme_name: Multi-Faith Community Institution Safety and Compliance Programme
lead_ministry_or_agency: Ministry of National Unity (delivered through the Department of National Unity and National Integration, JPNIN)
mandate_basis: Community cohesion and community-institution support are within the Ministry's mandate; this does not displace state land, local-government or religious-administration powers
supporting_agencies: State governments and local authorities; Public Works Department; Fire and Rescue Department; relevant State Islamic Religious Councils or authorities; Hindu, Christian, Sikh, Baha'i and other representative or trustee bodies
escalation_route: Named ministry delivery officer and accounting officer; automatic escalation under GC-06 to the senior-officials committee; land and local-government questions to the relevant state or federal-state forum; Islamic-administration questions to the relevant State Islamic Religious Council or authority; other institution-specific questions to the competent state body
notes: Federal delivery requires state, institutional and any applicable religious-authority consent for each participating facility. Common grants are religion-neutral and limited to life safety, accessibility, compliance and documented public-interest community-service spaces; they exclude worship, proselytisation, ceremonies, devotional fixtures and doctrinal activity. Temple and estate-legacy tenure, relocation and registration findings are documented only for state referral. This remains the weakest mandate in the portfolio and is gated by VAL-13. JPNIN does not hold a vote; the Ministry Secretary-General is the controlling officer (Pegawai Pengawal).

mandate_basis: School-based career guidance is an MOE function
supporting_agencies: Ministry of Higher Education; state education departments; TVET institutions; professional associations
escalation_route: Named ministry delivery officer and accounting officer; automatic escalation under GC-06 to the senior-officials committee
notes: Requires a data-sharing arrangement with MOHE and TVET institutions to close the destination-tracking loop.

mandate_basis: TVET coordination, skills development and employer engagement are within the Ministry of Human Resources mandate
supporting_agencies: Ministry of Higher Education; TVET institutions; Ministry of Education; employers and GLCs; HRD Corp
escalation_route: Named ministry delivery officer and accounting officer; automatic escalation under GC-06 to the senior-officials committee; employer commitments to the National TVET Council
notes: TVET provision is split across several ministries and agencies. A single accountable lead is assigned deliberately, but delivery depends on providers outside the lead's line authority.

mandate_basis: Matriculation programmes are administered by the Ministry of Education
supporting_agencies: Ministry of Higher Education; matriculation colleges; Public Service Department
escalation_route: Named ministry delivery officer and accounting officer; automatic escalation under GC-06 to the senior-officials committee; any policy question on intake framework to Cabinet
notes: The 90:10 intake framework is a standing policy matter. This programme requests publication and navigation only; it does not request reallocation of seats.

mandate_basis: Graduate employability is within the Ministry of Higher Education's mandate
supporting_agencies: Professional associations; universities; employers; Ministry of Human Resources
escalation_route: Named ministry delivery officer and accounting officer; automatic escalation under GC-06 to the senior-officials committee
notes: Depends on voluntary professional mentor supply which the government does not control.

mandate_basis: A cross-ministry case-coordination function does not sit naturally in any single line ministry; the coordinating role is assigned to the delivery secretariat
supporting_agencies: Department of Social Welfare; Ministry of Human Resources; Ministry of Housing and Local Government; MITRA; state welfare departments
accounting_officer: Chief Secretary to the Government (through the Director-General of the delivery secretariat)
escalation_route: Named ministry delivery officer and accounting officer; automatic escalation under GC-06 to the senior-officials committee
notes: This is a NEW function and requires an explicit Cabinet mandate and a data-sharing instrument between agencies. Navigators coordinate access to existing programmes; they do not approve benefits.

programme_name: Microenterprise Growth and Vendor Capability Programme
lead_ministry_or_agency: Ministry of Entrepreneur and Cooperatives Development
mandate_basis: Entrepreneur and SME development, including SME Corp and TEKUN, are within this Ministry's mandate
supporting_agencies: TEKUN Nasional; AIM; Bank Rakyat; SME Corp; MAICCI and KLSICCI; Ministry of Finance
accounting_officer: Secretary-General Ministry of Entrepreneur and Cooperatives Development
escalation_route: Named ministry delivery officer and accounting officer; automatic escalation under GC-06 to the senior-officials committee; procurement policy questions to MOF
notes: Procurement policy is a Ministry of Finance matter. This programme builds vendor capability; it does not and cannot alter procurement rules.

programme_name: Household Savings and Asset Accumulation Scheme
mandate_basis: Savings instruments and any matched-contribution scheme require Ministry of Finance design approval
supporting_agencies: Permodalan Nasional Berhad (subject to its own commercial decision); Bank Negara Malaysia; AIM; Department of Social Welfare
escalation_route: Named ministry delivery officer and accounting officer; automatic escalation under GC-06 to the senior-officials committee; instrument design to MOF and Cabinet
notes: PNB is a corporate entity and CANNOT be directed by Cabinet decision to allocate units. Its participation must be sought, not assumed. This is the single largest design dependency in the portfolio.

programme_name: Housing Access and Estate Legacy Resolution
lead_ministry_or_agency: Ministry of Housing and Local Government
mandate_basis: National housing policy and affordable housing programmes are within this Ministry's mandate
supporting_agencies: State housing agencies; SJKP; Ministry of Plantation and Commodities; state land offices; Department of Social Welfare
accounting_officer: Secretary-General Ministry of Housing and Local Government
escalation_route: Named ministry delivery officer and accounting officer; automatic escalation under GC-06 to the senior-officials committee; land matters to the relevant state
notes: Land is a state matter. Legacy land and compensation grievances cannot be resolved federally. The legacy review produces an administrative record for referral, not a federal determination.

mandate_basis: Public service recruitment policy, HRMIS and workforce planning are JPA functions
supporting_agencies: Public Service Commission (SPA); Ministry of Higher Education; Ministry of Education; universities; professional associations
escalation_route: Named ministry delivery officer and accounting officer; automatic escalation under GC-06 to the senior-officials committee
notes: Appointment decisions rest with the Public Service Commission, a constitutional body independent of the executive. The programme addresses application supply and preparation only, and makes no adjustment to entry standards.

mandate_basis: Officer development and INTAN are JPA functions
escalation_route: Named ministry delivery officer and accounting officer; automatic escalation under GC-06 to the senior-officials committee
notes: Promotion decisions rest with the relevant service commissions. This programme addresses access to development and publication of composition data only.

mandate_basis: Cabinet may establish a coordinating committee, designate a responsible minister and authorise a Chief Secretary-chaired or equivalent senior-officials mechanism and bounded secretariat within the Prime Minister's Department
supporting_agencies: All lead ministries; MITRA; Ministry of Finance; Implementation Coordination Unit
escalation_route: Named ministry delivery officer and accounting officer; automatic escalation under GC-06 to the senior-officials committee, designated minister and Cabinet
notes: The Prime Minister sponsors and strategically reviews; routine delivery follows GC-01 to GC-08. The coordinating bodies do not assume the statutory, vote, procurement or financial authority of any accounting officer and are not a 'legal successor' to MITRA or the MIB (CNF-026). Each programme retains its own accounting officer.

mandate_basis: Programme monitoring and evaluation for a Cabinet-established initiative sit with its secretariat
supporting_agencies: DOSM; Ministry of Economy; National Audit Department; independent evaluators
escalation_route: Named ministry delivery officer and accounting officer; automatic escalation under GC-06 to the senior-officials committee and Cabinet; audit findings to Parliament
notes: Requires a formal arrangement with DOSM for disaggregated statistics and a Data Protection Impact Assessment before any household-level record operates.
